cues.en: -: Now I'm going to show you how to implement permutation testing in code.
cues.zh: 現在示範如何用程式實作置換檢定。

cues.en: You will see that it's quite a bit different from all the other videos in this section.
cues.zh: 會和本章其他影片很不同。

cues.en: And furthermore, we're not going to call up any functions.
cues.zh: 而且不呼叫任何現成檢定函式。

cues.en: We are going to code the permutation testing and all the shuffling and everything all on our own from scratch.
cues.zh: 置換檢定、打亂，以及所有內容都從零自己寫。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start how we always start, by simulating datasets.
cues.zh: 照慣例，先模擬資料集。

cues.en: And now I'm gonna create two sample distributions.
cues.zh: 建立兩個樣本分布。

cues.en: You can see I have this kind of bizarre format for simulating these distributions, but you know, sometimes I just like to try and think a little bit outside the box just to come up with some weird looking
cues.zh: 模擬格式有點古怪，但有時喜歡跳出框架，想些看起來奇怪，

cues.en: or interesting looking distributions.
cues.zh: 或有趣的分布。

cues.en: So they start off being random numbers.
cues.zh: 先從隨機數開始。

cues.en: And then essentially I replace all of the positive values with the log of 1 plus those positive values.
cues.zh: 基本上，把所有正值換成 1 加上正值後的對數。

cues.en: And then I subtract everything from 26 and multiply by 10.
cues.zh: 再從 26 減去所有值，乘以 10。

cues.en: I don't really, I don't know what I'm doing here.
cues.zh: 不太知道這裡在做什麼。

cues.en: It's just some random stuff.
cues.zh: 只是隨機嘗試。

cues.en: Anyway, we compute some histograms.
cues.zh: 總之，計算直方圖。

cues.en: And then so dataset A and dataset B are almost exactly the same, except this offset parameter here is different.
cues.zh: A、B 幾乎相同，只有位移參數不同。

cues.en: So this is 26, and this is 30, and that's going to create our mean offset for these two datasets.
cues.zh: 這是 26，這是 30，造成兩組平均位移。

cues.en: Okay, and then again, histogram values for dataset B.
cues.zh: 再取得 B 的直方圖值。

cues.en: And then here I'm using a stem plot.
cues.zh: 這裡用豎線圖。

cues.en: So I don't believe I've shown a stem plot here, but it looks like a line plot, except the lines all go down to the bottom of the X axis instead of being drawn across.
cues.zh: 好像還沒展示過，看起來像折線圖，但線都垂直下降到 X 軸，不是橫向連接。

cues.en: And again, this kind of plot is appropriate for discreet data where we, you know, there's no reason to suspect that a value
cues.zh: 適合離散資料，因為沒有理由認為這裡

cues.en: at this, or data point, at this value would have this Y axis value.
cues.zh: 這個位置的資料點，就會有這個 Y 軸值。

cues.en: Now, to be honest, I'm actually not a huge fan of stem plots for showing multiple datasets at the same time.
cues.zh: 坦白說，不太喜歡用豎線圖同時呈現多組資料。

cues.en: I think they look a little bit confusing.
cues.zh: 有點混亂。

cues.en: It takes a little bit more time and effort to really see the shape of the two distributions.
cues.zh: 需要多花時間、精力，才能看出兩分布形狀。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I wanted to show you what stem plots look like and how to create them in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 但仍想展示豎線圖的樣子，以及如何在 MATLAB 建立。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Okay, so what we have here is two separate datasets, data A and data B, each 100 elements long.
cues.zh: 現在有 A、B 兩組分開資料，各 100 個元素。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do is mix the trials together.
cues.zh: 將試次混合。

cues.en: So I'm gonna concatenate the trials into this one vector called alldata.
cues.zh: 串接成一個叫 alldata 的向量。

cues.en: So now this variable, alldata, is 200 elements and the first 100 come from dataset A, and the next 100 come from dataset B.
cues.zh: alldata 有 200 個元素，前 100 個來自 A，後 100 個來自 B。

cues.en: And now we have to know what the condition mapping is.
cues.zh: 接著要知道條件映射。

cues.en: Now, in this case it's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 這裡很直接。

cues.en: It's just the first 100 are A, and the first 100 are B.
cues.zh: 前 100 個是 A，前 100 個是 B。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I'm gonna come up with this conds vector conditions vector, and that's just a concatenation of 1's and then 2's.
cues.zh: 但仍建立 conds 條件向量，就是先一串 1，再串接一串 2。

cues.en: So let me show you what this looks like.
cues.zh: 展示樣子。

cues.en: So here we have the data and oops, it's called alldata.
cues.zh: 這是資料，喔，叫 alldata。

cues.en: And actually I think I'll do it like this.
cues.zh: 其實改這樣。

cues.en: So concatenate them horizontally like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣水平串接。

cues.en: So alldata and then conds.
cues.zh: alldata，再接 conds。

cues.en: So now we can see that these up here, these are all the data points in condition 1.
cues.zh: 可以看到上面都是條件 1 的資料點。

cues.en: And then here we start the data points from condition 2.
cues.zh: 到這裡開始是條件 2。

cues.en: So that's pretty convenient.
cues.zh: 很方便。

cues.en: We now have a mapping, a vector, that maps each individual data point and its position in this alldata vector to the conditions 1 and 2.
cues.zh: 現在有映射向量，把 alldata 每個資料點及位置，對應條件 1、2。

cues.en: Now of course here these are kind of meaningless, but you know it's condition A and condition B.
cues.zh: 這裡名字沒什麼意義，就是 A、B。

cues.en: And of course, in real data you would be mapping these onto whatever the real conditions are.
cues.zh: 真實資料當然對應真正條件。

cues.en: Okay, so now what I'm going to do is illustrate the concept of permutation testing using one null hypothesis scenario.
cues.zh: 現在用一個虛無假設情境，示範置換檢定概念。

cues.en: So here's what I'm gonna do.
cues.zh: 做法如下。

cues.en: I'm gonna generate a shuffled condition labels vector.
cues.zh: 產生打亂後的條件標籤向量。

cues.en: So these are just randomly permuted numbers from 1 to 200 or N times 2.
cues.zh: 從 1 到 200，或 2N，隨機排列。

cues.en: And it's N times 2, of course, because we are concatenating these two datasets and each one is N points long.
cues.zh: 是 2N，因為串接兩組，每組長 N。

cues.en: And then what I do is set, randomly, I set half of them to be 1 and the other half to 2.
cues.zh: 再隨機將一半設為 1，另一半設為 2。

cues.en: So now you can see, so remember how this was set up before with allconds, or alldata and conds over here.
cues.zh: 記住，原本 alldata 和 conds 在這裡。

cues.en: And now I'm going to say fakeconds instead of the real conds.
cues.zh: 現在改用 fakeconds，而非真正 conds。

cues.en: Oops, this is a row.
cues.zh: 喔，這是一個列向量。

cues.en: Now, you can see that the labeling is shuffled.
cues.zh: 標籤被打亂了。

cues.en: So I haven't changed the data.
cues.zh: 資料沒變。

cues.en: The data are in exactly the same order, but the assignment between the condition label and the data point has been randomly shuffled around.
cues.zh: 資料順序完全相同，但條件標籤和資料點的對應，隨機打亂。

cues.en: So this is now, quote unquote, condition 1, and this data point is, quote unquote, condition 2.
cues.zh: 這個現在是加引號的條件 1，那個是加引號的條件 2。

cues.en: So again, we have the same data and the same number of labels, but we swap their assignment.
cues.zh: 相同資料、相同標籤數，但交換對應。

cues.en: We randomly assign different labels to go to different conditions.
cues.zh: 隨機指派不同標籤到不同條件。

cues.en: Okay, so now what I'm going to do is compute the average of the data from condition 1 and the average of the data from condition 2.
cues.zh: 接著計算條件 1 和條件 2 的資料平均。

cues.en: And I expect these to be different because that's how I simulated the data.
cues.zh: 預期不同，因為模擬就是這樣設定。

cues.en: So I said that data B, so I think data A should have an offset of 26, and this one should have an offset of 30.
cues.zh: A 應該位移 26，B 位移 30。

cues.en: And then, you know, with some random numbers on top, then they end up being different by about three numbers here, whatever these units correspond to.
cues.zh: 再加一些隨機數，最後大約差三個數值，不管單位是什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so then here's a question.
cues.zh: 問個問題。

cues.en: Should these two be different?
cues.zh: 這兩個應該不同嗎？

cues.en: So, and by these two, I'm going to average together all the data points from where this fakeconds vector equals 1.
cues.zh: 這兩個，是對 fakeconds=1 的所有資料點平均，

cues.en: And here where this fakeconds vector equals 2.
cues.zh: 以及 fakeconds=2 的點平均。

cues.en: Now in fact, we would expect these to be the same because we are totally mixing up all the different data points for these two conditions.
cues.zh: 預期相同，因為完全混合兩條件所有資料。

cues.en: Now, the fact that these are closer to each other, in fact, these are both somewhere in between here.
cues.zh: 它們比較接近，兩者都在這中間。

cues.en: So it almost looks like the average-ish.
cues.zh: 幾乎像取了平均。

cues.en: So somewhere in between these two.
cues.zh: 在原本兩個之間。

cues.en: Now the fact that these are actually different from each other is unexpected.
cues.zh: 實際彼此不同，是預期之外的。

cues.en: We would expect that these two are exactly the same.
cues.zh: 預期兩者完全相同。

cues.en: The means should be the same because we are creating a scenario under the null hypothesis, and the null hypothesis is that both of these conditions,
cues.zh: 平均應相同，因為建立虛無假設情境，而虛無假設是兩個條件，

cues.en: cond A, condition A and B, or here I'm calling 'em 1 and 2, are really drawn from one common condition.
cues.zh: A、B，或這裡稱為 1、2，來自同個共同條件。

cues.en: So that's the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這是虛無假設。

cues.en: So the null hypothesis predicts that these are the same.
cues.zh: 預測它們相同。

cues.en: Now they're not exactly the same, and that's because of sampling variability.
cues.zh: 不完全相同，是因為抽樣變異。

cues.en: We could run this code again.
cues.zh: 可以重跑。

cues.en: So here this is 29.9 and 28.0.
Now I'm gonna run all this code again, and now it's 29.5 and 28.0.
So they're a little bit different here than they were up here.
cues.zh: 和上面稍有不同。

cues.en: So that's just due to random variability coming from this random permutation.
cues.zh: 只是隨機置換造成的隨機變異。

cues.en: Okay, so the point of that is that we can't really trust one single null hypothesis iteration.
cues.zh: 重點是，不能相信單次虛無假設迭代。

cues.en: That's why we create a distribution of null hypothesis mean differences here.
cues.zh: 所以建立虛無假設平均差的分布。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're gonna do is loop over 1000 permutations.
cues.zh: 跑 1000 次置換。

cues.en: So we're gonna do this 1000 times and all these, so these three lines of code are the same as these three lines of code.
cues.zh: 重複 1000 次，這三行和那三行相同。

cues.en: So we're just shuffling the condition labels randomly.
cues.zh: 只是隨機打亂條件標籤。

cues.en: Let me actually close this.
cues.zh: 先關這個。

cues.en: And now you can see what I'm storing at each iteration.
cues.zh: 現在看每次儲存什麼。

cues.en: So I'm storing 1000 times, the average difference.
cues.zh: 儲存 1000 次平均差。

cues.en: So this is the mean of, maybe I'll put some spaces in here to make it a little bit clearer.
cues.zh: 這是平均，也許加一些空白，比較清楚。

cues.en: So the mean of all data where the fake condition label is 2 minus the mean of all data where the fake condition label is 1.
cues.zh: 假條件標籤 2 的所有資料平均，減去假標籤 1 的資料平均。

cues.en: Again, this difference is the difference between these two, and we expect this to be distributed around zero.
cues.zh: 就是這兩個之差，預期分布在 0 周圍。

cues.en: Okay, so I'll run those, and then you can see I'm gonna make a histogram of these null hypothesis distributions.
cues.zh: 執行，再畫這些虛無假設分布的直方圖。

cues.en: Okay, so here you see the null, empirical null hypothesis distribution, and it's pretty interesting that it is roughly Gaussian-ish.
cues.zh: 這裡是經驗虛無假設分布，有趣的是大致像高斯。

cues.en: It looks a little bit like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 有點高斯的樣子。

cues.en: And again, we expect these values to be zero, and they are less and less frequent as they get further and further away from zero.
cues.zh: 預期為 0，而離 0 越遠，出現越少。

cues.en: And again, this is just due to random sampling variability.
cues.zh: 同樣只是隨機抽樣變異。

cues.en: Okay, so now, we have our distribution of null hypothesis values, and then what we do is consider the actual, the observed test statistic here.
cues.zh: 有了虛無假設值分布，再考慮真正觀察統計量。

cues.en: Now also notice that I'm not actually computing a T-test.
cues.zh: 也注意，其實沒計算 t 檢定。

cues.en: I'm just taking the difference of the means.
cues.zh: 只是取平均差。

cues.en: Now, maybe you think that the difference of the means is not really an appropriate way to test these because we only have the numerator of the T-test.
cues.zh: 也許認為只取平均差不適當，因為只有 t 檢定分子。

cues.en: We're not normalizing, we're not scaling by the variance.
cues.zh: 沒有正規化，沒有用變異數縮放。

cues.en: So that is an interesting point in here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個有趣重點。

cues.en: We are not scaling these observed values by the variance or by the pool standard deviation and square root of N.
cues.zh: 沒有用變異數，或合併標準差及 N 的平方根，縮放觀察值。

cues.en: So that means that this is actually difficult to interpret on its own.
cues.zh: 所以單獨很難解讀。

cues.en: However, whatever I'm doing here, I'm also doing here in the permutation testing.
cues.zh: 但這裡做的事，也在置換中做。

cues.en: So whatever scale from the data is appearing inside the test statistic here is also the same in this permutation distribution.
cues.zh: 因此，檢定統計量中出現的資料尺度，在置換分布中也相同。

cues.en: That's a really powerful feature of permutation testing that any, you know, original scaling, any normalization, or lack of normalization, any weird things
cues.zh: 這是置換很強大的特點：任何原始尺度、正規化，或缺少正規化，或奇怪的

cues.en: that are happening in the data, also go into the null hypothesis equally.
cues.zh: 資料特性，也同等進入虛無假設。

cues.en: So it's quite robust to sort of weird things happening in the data, as long as you have a reasonable sample size.
cues.zh: 只要樣本數合理，對資料中的奇怪情況相當穩健。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, so here we go.
cues.zh: 總之。

cues.en: This is our observed data, and you can see it's quite far away from this empirical null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這是觀察資料，可以看到離經驗虛無假設分布很遠。

cues.en: And then of course, the next question is whether it's sufficiently far away for us to deem this a statistically significant result.
cues.zh: 下一個問題，是是否夠遠，可以視為統計顯著。

cues.en: So that's what we do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就做這件事。

cues.en: We compute a Z value.
cues.zh: 計算 Z。

cues.en: This is the observed value minus the mean of the permutation distribution divided by the standard deviation of the permutation distribution.
cues.zh: 觀察值減去置換分布平均，再除以置換分布標準差。

cues.en: So that's the Z value.
cues.zh: 這是 Z 值。

cues.en: And then the P value is simply interpreting that or evaluating that Z value in a normal CDF or a Gaussian function accumulative distribution.
cues.zh: P 值就是把 Z 放到常態 CDF、高斯累積分布函數中評估。

cues.en: Okay, and then, well, let's see what this is actually.
cues.zh: 看看實際結果。

cues.en: It's gonna be pretty large, or pretty small I mean.
cues.zh: 會很大，應該說很小。

cues.en: The Z value is pretty large.
cues.zh: Z 值很大。

cues.en: So here we get a P value of 0.0047.
And by the way, is this a one-tailed or two-tailed P value that I'm looking at here?
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這是單尾還是雙尾 P 值？

cues.en: So it's something for you to think about here.
cues.zh: 留給你想想。

cues.en: Okay, and then the other method for computing the P value that I discussed in the previous lecture is based on counting.
cues.zh: 前一堂介紹的另一種方法，是計數。

cues.en: So here what we do is count the number of null hypothesis values that are larger than our observed value,
cues.zh: 計算大於觀察值的虛無假設值數量，

cues.en: which is this guy here.
cues.zh: 觀察值就是這個。

cues.en: So we count the number of exceedances and then divide by the total number of permutations, and that ends up being 0.004 in this particular case.
cues.zh: 計算超過的次數，再除以置換總數，這次是 0.004。

cues.en: So that's interesting to see that these are not identical but really, really close to each other.
cues.zh: 兩者不完全相同，但非常接近，很有趣。

cues.en: And that's in general something you will find when the null hypothesis distribution is roughly Gaussian distributed.
cues.zh: 虛無假設分布大致高斯時，通常會如此。

cues.en: You will find that these two methods of computing a P value are generally pretty similar to each other.
cues.zh: 兩種 P 值計算法通常相當相似。

cues.en: So you can do one or the other.
cues.zh: 可以選其中一種。

cues.en: So here's how I simulated the data for this code video.
cues.zh: 以下是這部程式影片的資料模擬方式。

cues.en: It's a little bit of a weird way to simulate the data, and I'm not totally sure what was going through my head here, but you know, sometimes I just like to try out random things
cues.zh: 有點奇怪，不太記得當時在想什麼，但有時喜歡隨機嘗試，

cues.en: or sort of weird things just to see what happens.
cues.zh: 做些奇怪的事，看看會怎樣。

cues.en: All right, so we are generating 100 trials or 100 data points per condition, per dataset.
cues.zh: 每個條件、每組產生 100 個試次、資料點。

cues.en: They start off as being normally distributed numbers.
cues.zh: 一開始是常態分布數字。

cues.en: And then what I do is take all of the positive values and take the log transform of those positive values.
cues.zh: 再對所有正值取對數轉換。

cues.en: And then I, you know, multiply them by 10 and subtract from 26.
cues.zh: 乘以 10，再從 26 減去。

cues.en: Honestly, I don't really remember what I was thinking when I came up with this, but, you know, just to generate some data.
cues.zh: 老實說，不記得當時想什麼，只是產生資料。

cues.en: So, then here I'm taking the histogram because we're gonna wanna see the distributions of these datasets.
cues.zh: 計算直方圖，因為要看資料集分布。

cues.en: So this was dataset A, here you can see dataset B, and they are formed in the same way.
cues.zh: 這是 A，這是 B，建立方式相同。

cues.en: The only difference is this offset value here, which is 26 for dataset A and 30 for dataset B.
cues.zh: 唯一差別是位移值，A 為 26，B 為 30。

cues.en: Again, I take the histogram of dataset B, and then here, oops, I need to import these modules here.
cues.zh: 再取 B 的直方圖；喔，需要先匯入模組。

cues.en: And the way that I'm showing them here is something called a stem plot.
cues.zh: 這裡用所謂豎線圖。

cues.en: And I don't believe I've introduced you to stem plots yet in this course, but they're pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 好像課程還沒介紹，但相當直接。

cues.en: It's just like a line plot, except the lines go down to the bottom vertically, straight down to the bottom of the X axis for each individual data point
cues.zh: 像折線圖，但線對每個資料點垂直降到 X 軸底部，

cues.en: instead of connecting the data points.
cues.zh: 不是連接資料點。

cues.en: Now, for a dataset like this, and particularly for a histogram, this is an appropriate way to visualize the data because we're not making any indications
cues.zh: 對這類資料，尤其直方圖，是合適方式，因為沒有暗示

cues.en: or assumptions about what a data point here would have as its value.
cues.zh: 或假設這裡的資料點應有什麼值。

cues.en: Now to be honest, I'm not such a fan of using stem plots to show multiple distributions in the same plot.
cues.zh: 坦白說，不太喜歡在同張圖用豎線圖顯示多個分布。

cues.en: And that's because as you can see, it gets kind of difficult to see the shape of the distributions for the two different datasets.
cues.zh: 因為可以看到，有點難看清兩組資料的分布形狀。

cues.zh: 不是不可能，但要看一陣子，才理解形狀。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I wanted to include this here just so you see what a stem plot looks like and how to create one.
cues.zh: 但仍放進來，讓你知道豎線圖的樣子和建立方式。

cues.zh: Python 有一點奇怪設定。

cues.en: Actually, let me, I can even get rid of this just to show you why I have this marker format specified and also the base format specified.
cues.zh: 可以去掉這些，展示為什麼指定 marker 格式、基線格式。

cues.en: Okay, so now we have two separate datasets and we want to compare them.
cues.zh: 現在有兩組分開資料，要比較。

cues.en: We want to know whether there's a significant difference in the means of these two datasets.
cues.zh: 想知道平均值是否顯著不同。

cues.en: So the way that I'm gonna go about doing this is by first creating a single vector that is called alldata, and it's basically
cues.zh: 先建立叫 alldata 的單一向量，基本上就是

cues.en: the concatenation of these two datasets.
cues.zh: 串接兩組資料。

cues.en: So this vector now contains 200 elements, and the first 100 come from data A and the second 100 come from data B.
cues.zh: 200 個元素，前 100 個來自 A，後 100 個來自 B。

cues.en: And now I need a way to identify which data points come from dataset A and which data points come from dataset B.
cues.zh: 需要辨識哪些點來自 A、哪些來自 B。

cues.en: So that's why I'm creating this separate conditions label here.
cues.zh: 所以另建條件標籤。

cues.en: You can see the code is set up pretty similar to here, except this is now 1's and this is 2's.
cues.zh: 程式設定相似，只是這裡是 1，那裡是 2。

cues.en: So actually let me print these out to make sure that it's really clear.
cues.zh: 印出來，確保很清楚。

cues.en: So I'm gonna print out alldata and then I'm gonna print out conds.
cues.zh: 印 alldata，再印 conds。

cues.en: So here is all data.
cues.zh: 這是所有資料。

cues.en: So you can see this is both of our datasets just concatenated next to each other.
cues.zh: 可以看到，只是兩組並排串接。

cues.en: You don't see in this vector where dataset 1 ends and where dataset 2 begins.
cues.zh: 從向量看不出第一組在哪結束、第二組在哪開始。

cues.en: And that's why I have this conds factor here.
cues.zh: 所以需要 conds 向量。

cues.en: So this tells us that the first data point is condition 1, the second data point is condition 2, and so on.
cues.zh: 第一個點為條件 1，第二個點為條件 2，依此類推。

cues.en: Here is the break to condition 2, and then the rest of them are in condition 2.
cues.zh: 這裡切換到條件 2，之後全是條件 2。

cues.en: Okay, so now what we're going to do is generate one scenario under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 現在產生一個虛無假設下的情境。

cues.en: Now, the null hypothesis here is that both of our conditions are actually drawn from a single distribution with a common mean.
cues.zh: 虛無假設是，兩條件其實來自一個具有共同平均值的分布。

cues.en: So that would suggest, or that predicts, the null hypothesis predicts, that if we compute the mean of dataset 1 and the mean of dataset 2
cues.zh: 因此預測，計算第一組平均與第二組平均，

cues.en: and subtract those two means, that mean difference should be zero, right?
cues.zh: 兩者相減，平均差應為 0，對吧？

cues.en: If they're really being drawn from the same distribution, which is what the null hypothesis is.
cues.zh: 如果真的如虛無假設所說，來自同分布。

cues.en: Okay, so the way that I'm going to implement this is generate a new vector.
cues.zh: 實作方式，是產生新向量。

cues.en: I'm calling this fakeconds because these are fake condition labels.
cues.zh: 稱為 fakeconds，因為是假條件標籤。

cues.en: So what I'm doing is coming up with a random ordering of numbers between zero and 199.
cues.zh: 產生 0 到 199 的數字隨機排序。

cues.en: So basically like this.
cues.zh: 基本上像這樣。

cues.en: And then I'm calling half of them, randomly, I'm labeling half of them 1 and half of them 2.
cues.zh: 再隨機把一半標記 1，另一半標記 2。

cues.en: So let me show you what this looks like.
cues.zh: 展示一下。

cues.en: Before I get to this, I'm gonna print fakeconds.
cues.zh: 在這之前，先印 fakeconds。

cues.en: So here you see this is very different from the actual conds that I had above.
cues.zh: 和上面真正 conds 很不一樣。

cues.en: So we have 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, and so on.
So you can see that when we link the data to these labels, now the labeling is wrong, but importantly, the data are preserved.
cues.zh: 把資料連結標籤，標籤現在錯了，但重要的是資料保留。

cues.en: So I'm not changing the data.
cues.zh: 沒有改資料。

cues.en: I'm also not changing the number of condition labels.
cues.zh: 也沒有改標籤數。

cues.en: All I'm doing is randomly swapping the assignment of condition label to a specific data value.
cues.zh: 只隨機交換條件標籤和特定資料值的對應。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's un-print this.
cues.zh: 現在取消列印。

cues.en: Let's start with this one.
cues.zh: 先從這個開始。

cues.en: So these two means should be different.
cues.zh: 這兩個平均應該不同。

cues.en: Okay, so we are printing out here the average of the real data with the real condition labels set to 1.
cues.zh: 這裡印的是，真正標籤為 1 的真實資料平均。

cues.en: So this is the average of the data from condition 1.
cues.zh: 條件 1 的平均。

cues.en: And here we have the average of the data from condition 2.
cues.zh: 這裡是條件 2 平均。

cues.en: So here you see those averages.
cues.zh: 可以看到這些平均。

cues.en: It's around 28 and a little over 29.
cues.zh: 大約 28，以及略高於 29。

cues.en: Now, those I expect to be different because of how I simulated the data.
cues.zh: 根據模擬方式，預期不同。

cues.en: In fact, I would expect this to be closer to 26 and this to be a bit closer to 30.
cues.zh: 其實預期這個更接近 26，那個更接近 30。

cues.en: But of course there's random sampling variability, random numbers that are getting into this and so on.
cues.zh: 但當然有隨機抽樣變異、隨機數等等。

cues.en: Okay, but now, this one, we expect these conditions to be, or these numbers to be the same.
cues.zh: 現在這裡，預期條件、或者數字相同。

cues.en: We don't expect these to be different because I'm using this vector, fake labels, which has randomized condition labels.
cues.zh: 因為用 fake labels 向量，條件標籤已隨機化，不預期不同。

cues.en: So in fact, we expect these two numbers, these two averages to be the same.
cues.zh: 所以預期兩個數字、兩個平均相同。

cues.en: Now in fact, they are not the same.
cues.zh: 但實際不相同。

cues.en: In fact, in this particular instance, they seem to be just about as far apart as the original labels.
cues.zh: 這次差距，似乎和原始標籤差不多。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna run this code again and that's gonna generate new fake condition labels.
cues.zh: 再執行，產生新假標籤。

cues.en: Now you see, oh, now they're even further apart.
cues.zh: 喔，現在甚至更遠。

cues.en: That's an interesting thing.
cues.zh: 很有趣。

cues.en: And now they're all, they're still pretty far apart.
cues.zh: 現在仍然差很遠。

cues.en: Okay, so this is gonna be a pretty interesting case.
cues.zh: 這會是很有趣的情況。

cues.en: I am not sure whether we are going to find a statistically significant difference.
cues.zh: 不確定是否會找到統計顯著差異。

cues.en: Now, this is just one random shuffling, but the thing is we can't really trust one random shuffling, and that's because it might happen by chance
cues.zh: 這只是一次隨機打亂，但不能相信單次，因為可能偶然

cues.en: that this contains more larger data values and this contains more small data values.
cues.zh: 讓這組有更多大值，那組更多小值。

cues.en: So what we want to do is repeat this shuffling many, many times and then build up an empirical null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 所以要重複很多次，建立經驗虛無假設分布。

cues.en: And that's what we do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是如此。

cues.en: So I'm going through 1000 permutations, and inside this loop over 1000 iterations in the permutation testing, I'm running these three lines that's identical
cues.zh: 跑 1000 次置換，迴圈裡這三行，和

cues.en: to these three lines of code here.
cues.zh: 這邊三行完全相同。

cues.en: So again, this is generating our fake condition labels.
cues.zh: 同樣產生假條件標籤。

cues.en: And what I'm storing here at each iteration of the permutation testing is the difference of the means.
cues.zh: 每次儲存平均差。

cues.en: So the average of the data points with the fake condition label 2 minus the mean of the data points with fake condition label 1.
cues.zh: 假標籤 2 的平均，減去假標籤 1 的平均。

cues.en: And again, this is our empirical null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這是經驗虛無假設分布。

cues.en: We expect this to be centered around zero, and it's gonna have some kind of distribution around zero because we are doing random permutations here.
cues.zh: 預期中心在 0，因為隨機置換，會在 0 附近有某種分布。

cues.en: Okay, and then we create a histogram.
cues.zh: 再建立直方圖。

cues.en: And then, actually let's first look at that histogram and see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 先看看樣子。

cues.en: Okay, so here is our null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這是虛無假設分布。

cues.en: This is our empirical distribution that we expect under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 在虛無假設下預期的經驗分布。

cues.en: And then what I do here is compute the observed value.
cues.zh: 接著計算觀察值。

cues.en: So this is the mean of actual condition 2 with the real condition labels minus the mean of actual condition 1 with the real condition labels.
cues.zh: 真正標籤條件 2 的平均，減去真正標籤條件 1 的平均。

cues.en: And then I'm just gonna plot that as a magenta line over here.
cues.zh: 再用洋紅色線畫在這裡。

cues.en: All right, so here you see the observed difference relative to the, or embedded in the null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，觀察差異相對於、或者嵌入虛無假設分布的位置。

cues.en: And now the question is, is this thing far enough away from the center of this distribution in order for us to be able to label this statistically significant?
cues.zh: 問題是，離中心夠遠，可以標為統計顯著嗎？

cues.en: And I showed you in the slides in the previous video that there are two methods for evaluating the statistical significance of this result.
cues.zh: 前一部投影片介紹過兩種評估方式。

cues.en: The first one is this Z value here.
cues.zh: 第一個是 Z 值。

cues.en: So I take the observed value and I subtract the mean of the permutation differences here, so the permuted or the empirical null hypothesis
cues.zh: 觀察值減去置換差異平均，也就是經驗虛無假設

cues.en: distribution, and then divide by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 分布的平均，再除以標準差。

cues.en: And actually this should probably be degrees of freedom equals 1.
cues.zh: 其實這裡自由度應該設為 1。

cues.en: So this gives me a normal Z value, like a standard deviation units value, and that I can evaluate using a normal CDF.
cues.zh: 得到一般 Z 值、以標準差為單位，再用常態 CDF 評估。

cues.en: So a normal distribution cumulative density function.
cues.zh: 也就是常態分布累積密度函數。

cues.en: And then, so this was one way to get a P value.
cues.zh: 這是一種取得 P 值的方式。

cues.en: The second way to get a P value was what I call the count method, the pCount method.
cues.zh: 第二種是計數法，pCount。

cues.en: And what we do is count the number of null hypothesis iterations, null hypothesis mean values,
cues.zh: 計算虛無假設迭代、平均值中，

cues.en: that were larger than our observed value in the real data.
cues.zh: 大於真實資料觀察值的個數。

cues.en: So we sum up all the elements here that are larger than the observed value and then divide by the total number of permutations.
cues.zh: 加總所有大於觀察值的元素個數，再除以置換總數。

cues.en: And that gives us our pCount, P value.
cues.zh: 得到 pCount、P 值。

cues.en: And there are two things that are noteworthy here.
cues.zh: 有兩點值得注意。

cues.en: One is that these two values are pretty similar to each other.
cues.zh: 第一，兩值相當類似。

cues.en: They're not exactly the same, but they are pretty close to each other.
cues.zh: 不完全相同，但很接近。

cues.en: And that's generally what you'll find when the null hypothesis distribution is roughly Gaussian distributed.
cues.zh: 虛無假設大致高斯時，通常會如此。

cues.en: Something like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: Then you will find that these two methods of deriving a P value are convergent.
cues.zh: 兩種 P 值計算法會得到相近結果。

cues.en: And the second thing that you notice is that this is nowhere near significant.
cues.zh: 第二，這完全不接近顯著。

cues.en: This is definitely not a significant result, and that should also be pretty obvious from looking at how close this observed value is to the center of this null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 肯定不顯著，從觀察值離虛無假設分布中心多近，也應看得出。

cues.en: Okay, so there's one final thing that I want to discuss in this video, and that is one of the advantages of permutation testing.
cues.zh: 最後想討論置換檢定的一個優點。

cues.en: Now, you'll notice here that I didn't actually compute a T value.
cues.zh: 注意，其實沒計算 t 值。

cues.en: So I'm not dividing by a pooled variance.
cues.zh: 沒除以合併變異數。

cues.en: I'm not dividing by standard deviation divided by square root of N.
cues.zh: 沒除以標準差除以 N 平方根。

cues.en: I'm not doing any denominator normalization.
cues.zh: 沒有做任何分母正規化。

cues.en: This is really just the numerator of the T-test up here.
cues.zh: 只是上面 t 檢定的分子。

cues.en: Now, initially that might seem strange.
cues.zh: 一開始可能覺得奇怪。

cues.en: It might seem a little weird because I'm not normalizing for the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 因為沒有依標準差正規化。

cues.en: So then you might think, well, how can we really interpret these values on their own?
cues.zh: 可能想，如何單獨解讀這些值？

cues.en: They're in whatever the scale of the data are.
cues.zh: 使用原始資料的尺度。

cues.en: But the thing to keep in mind is that whatever weird scaling or lack of scaling is going on with the data, whatever weird stuff is happening with the actual data,
cues.zh: 但要記住，真實資料有任何奇怪尺度，或缺少縮放、任何奇怪特性，

cues.en: we are, all of that weird stuff or lack of normalization, is also going into all these permutations.
cues.zh: 也全部進入這些置換。

cues.en: So anything that's present in the data is also present in the permutation testing.
cues.zh: 資料有的，置換檢定也有。

cues.en: So permutation testing is therefore pretty robust to scaling artifacts and some weird stuff that happens in the data.
cues.zh: 因此對尺度造成的假象，以及資料中的一些奇怪情況，相當穩健。

cues.en: Again, that's because we are computing an empirical null hypothesis distribution, and that will include any weird stuff that's happening in the data.
cues.zh: 因為計算的是經驗虛無假設分布，它會納入資料中的這些特性。
